notes.title: PATCH 9 -- 2023-09-22
notes.content:
Fixed music_resume scripting command.
Fixed scenario selection menu bugs.

notes.title: PATCH 8 -- 2023-09-18
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where some map music would be skipped when playing multiple games in a row.
You can now edit mod description text boxes without accidentally exiting the menu.

notes.title: PATCH 7 -- 2023-06-13
notes.content:
Controller issue fixed.
Map music resumes after the "Meanwhile..." message, instead of when the message appears.
Text fixes.

notes.title: PATCH 6 -- 2023-05-17
notes.content:
New job, 'librarian' added.
New skill, 'librarycard' added for the librarian job.
statlosschest sprite added
mysterybox sprite added
pompom follower audio added

notes.title: PATCH 5 -- 2023-05-08
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where enemy misses could still deal a bit of damage if they were 'pumped'.
The skill 'trashcollector' now has a cap on how many items can be found
New job, 'wrestler' added.
New skill, 'bearhug' added for the wrestler job.
New skill, 'tagteam' added for the wrestler job.
adjusted crybulb
New special monster, 'forestkeeper' added.
added message_add command to allow for leading and ending space strings to be used in add command
Text fixes.

notes.title: PATCH 4 -- 2023-04-17
notes.content:
4 new chance events, mostly roads to add some more variation during travel time. One region 1 town/road, two region 1-4 road and one region 2-4 road. 
Social Networking now has an effect on the chances of followers proccing.
Brings up a popup if you're about to sell your only copy of your currently equipped piece of gear.
Value by Association no longer gives cash when associating with others with the same skill.
New face shapes added.

notes.title: PATCH 3 -- 2023-04-13
notes.content:
Balance on the skill Devil's Advocate
Raised base damage on the skill Grating Voice.
Muscle Pump cost balance.
Crybulb's spell have higher recharge time.
Can skip the upload mod screen with the cancel button on the admin controller.
Text fixes.
Slightly raised base damage on the skill Analyze.
Reworked Double Edge into an attack skill that raises Crit chance at the cost of a bit of HP.

notes.title: PATCH 2 -- 2023-04-03
notes.content:
Fixed job reward tables no longer being cleared on load.
Fixed the MoveFX flash effect having a hit time below 1 (it just generated a log output).
Monsters should be able to load portraits from the mods for use on the board now.
Changed ZR and ZL button images.
Link to the workshop in the scenario menu.
Special case trigger for magic recycling and thrifter, allowing only one player to have the chance to copy the item.

notes.title: PATCH 1 -- 2023-03-28
notes.content:
Fixed charitable skill when using healing spells.
Added descriptive text whenever you get a new follower.
Added the sound PlayerJobChangeFailed.
Fixed some events showing the wrong name in the dialogue box.
Fixed a bug where the furnacedungeon event allowed players to continue their turn after combat which ultimately would cause a crash.
Fixed the text on the second teleporter (previously its own tile in text).
Added extra text to some items in the "currently equipped" window.
Fixed mouse scroll in the invite screen, previously it would return the user to the main menu.
